ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- Conditions to effectiveness: required email consents from the Credit Parties and from the Term Loan Agent and “Required Forbearing Lenders” confirming amendment of the Term Loan Forbearance Period termination date to October 1, 2020 (in form and substance reasonably acceptable to the Agent and Lenders).
- Expense reimbursement obligation: Credit Parties’ agreement to promptly reimburse the Agent for all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket costs and expenses per Section 13.01(i) of the Credit Agreement, including Proskauer Rose LLP fees.
- Payment timing/mechanics for M-III retainer: $50,000 evergreen retainer due within one Business Day after invoice (with wire instructions) and may be applied by M-III against amounts owing.
